title: Water sample chain-of-custody log
summary: Keeps water samples identifiable when official testing or community comparison is possible.
content: Water sample chain-of-custody log is a practical offline routine for water testing records. Label source, exact place, date, time, collector, weather, recent flood/fire/repair, and intended test if known. Do not touch inside the cap or container with dirty hands. Collect before treatment and after treatment only in clearly separate labeled containers. Record who handled the sample so results can be trusted. Do not use home observation as proof that water is safe.
